verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a built-in MCP server that lets external AI tools pull issue data, stack traces, and event details for investigation, which enables AI-native workflows but the analysis/root-cause proposal is performed by the connecting AI tool, not GlitchTip itself. There's no evidence of an in-product AI feature that synthesizes stack traces, breadcrumbs, and commits into a root-cause suggestion. Missing for 10: native AI analysis engine, breadcrumb/commit correlation, first-party root-cause suggestions, and independent validation of AI-tool output quality.
